name: 13.3 – Rappel déclaration URSSAF avec CA pré-calculé

parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(montant_ttc), 0)::float AS ca,
       COUNT(*)::int AS nb_factures
FROM factures
WHERE statut = 'payee'
  AND date_paiement >= $1::date AND date_paiement < $2::date
